about: Maps Microsoft's Windows component names to Patchmap areas. 'match' is a pattern checked against the component name (e.g. 'Windows Print Spooler Components'). A component can get several tags. Edit freely; re-run fetch_msrc.py.

sign-in.label: Sign-in and identity
sign-in.match: kerberos|ntlm|lsass|local security authority|ldap|active directory|authentication|credential|netlogon|smart card|hello|certificate|entra|security account|biometric|key distribution center

file-sharing.label: File sharing
file-sharing.match: smb|server message block|\bnfs\b|file server|\bdfs\b|offline files|webdav|client-side caching

network.label: Network
network.match: dns|domain name|dhcp|tcp/ip|routing|rras|http\.sys|\bike\b|remote procedure call|\brpc\b|wireless|wi-fi|bluetooth|network|winsock|ancillary function|upnp|universal plug and play|internet connection sharing|sstp|secure socket tunneling|filtering platform|firewall|function discovery|netbios|ndis|ssdp|link layer|wininet|internet \(wininet|vmswitch

security.label: Security features
security.match: bitlocker|secure boot|encrypting file system|\befs\b|cryptograph|schannel|defender|firewall|filtering platform|smartscreen|virtualization-based security|\bvbs\b|\btpm\b|code integrity|applocker|biometric|kernel-mode|luafv|security center|host guardian|boot manager|application identity|appid

management.label: Management and admin tools
management.match: management instrumentation|\bwmi\b|\bmdm\b|device management|management services|event log|event tracing|task scheduler|powershell|performance monitor|autopilot|deployment services|server update service|group policy|error reporting|telemetry|background intelligent transfer|\bbits\b|diagnostic|performance counters|setup files cleanup

storage.label: Storage and file systems
storage.match: storage|ntfs|refs|resilient file|overlay filter|spaceport|projected file system|iscsi|brokering file system|backup|scsi|cloud files|volume|\bdisk|fat|file history

apps-desktop.label: Desktop and apps
apps-desktop.match: search component|shell|file explorer|push notification|broadcast dvr|audio|media|midi|speech|camera|clipboard|text shaping|windows runtime|\bole\b|\bcom\b|com\+|app store|program compatibility|device association|sensor|staterepository|telephony|libarchive|directmusic|notepad|paint|snipping|widgets|start menu|taskbar|text services|user interface core|rich text|notification|accessibility|codecs|core messaging|wallet

server-roles.match: message queuing|failover cluster|internet information services|\biis\b|hyper-v|deployment services|server update service|iscsi target|dhcp server|dns server|remote access
